Music Assistant plugin provider that exposes MA players to **Yandex Alice via a
Yandex Dialogs custom skill** — a Russian-NLU voice control surface for
Music Assistant.

This repository is the voice-skill side of the integration that previously
lived inside [`ma-provider-yandex-smarthome`](https://github.com/trudenboy/ma-provider-yandex-smarthome).
It was extracted into its own provider so users who only want voice control
don't have to deal with the Smart Home device-bridge config flow, and vice
versa. See the [extraction PLAN](https://github.com/trudenboy/ma-provider-yandex-smarthome/issues)
for the full architectural rationale.

## Status

🚧 **Bootstrap.** Workflow files are auto-generated by
[`ma-provider-tools`](https://github.com/trudenboy/ma-provider-tools) once this
repo is registered in `providers.yml`; provider source lands in a follow-up
PR. First release: `1.0.0` (planned).

## Voice command surface (preview)

Once configured, the skill responds to commands such as:

- *«Алиса, попроси Music Assistant включить джаз на кухне»*
- *«… что играет?»* / *«… перемешай»* / *«… повтор песни»*
- *«… перемотай вперёд на минуту»* / *«… к началу»*
- *«… переведи на спальню»* / *«… добавь Metallica»*

…and the standard play / pause / stop / next / previous / volume / mute set
inherited from the Smart Home provider.

## Runtime dependencies

- [`ya-passport-auth`](https://pypi.org/project/ya-passport-auth/) — Yandex
  Passport authentication (Device Flow OAuth, QR login, x_token refresh).
- [`ya-dialogs-api`](https://pypi.org/project/ya-dialogs-api/) — Yandex Dialogs
  Developer API client (programmatic skill creation, draft management,
  publication polling).
